title: Transcript from outer query bits
statement: Let $n$ be positive, and let a Boolean proof-checking system with input length $n$, proof length $\ell$, and $r$ query positions be given. For every Boolean input word, proof word, and verifier seed, the local transcript formed from the outer query bits equals the verifier’s transcript obtained by querying the combined input and proof word.
